title: 第 52章 再逛鸽子市

第 52章 再逛鸽子市-《穿越60带着空间当保安》

王野开始慢悠悠的溜达，都是一些生活用品，卖粮食很少。倒是有几个卖古玩的，可是现在王野还不认识这些东西。

并不是说后世造假的多，现在少。只是现在古董不值钱，造假的成本太高，所以市面上相对少点。就王野的水平，西周的和上周的都分不清。

王野现在可不会托大，有个现成的先生，凭王野的能力，学习一下鉴定应该不难。鉴定无外乎知识储备和实践能力。

知识储备就永宁先生的书房，应该够用了，实践能力更不用说了，王野空间里有很多的古董，有的是让他上手实践的。

王野边走边看，真让王野看见一个让他感兴趣的。这时一个老头，在摊位上摆满了冷兵器，这东西在现在还是很有市场的。

王野蹲在摊位前，看着琳琅满目的兵器说：“大爷，这怎么卖的？”

大爷说：“大件两块，小件一块，有粮食最好。”

王野拿起一把匕首刮了刮刀刃，掂了点分量，感觉还不错，但是和他的短刀就差远了。

王野随口一问：“大爷有更好的吗？”

摆摊大爷被这么一问，知道这是来生意了，赶紧说：“小伙子想要多好的？我这已经算是精品了。”

王野见大爷这样答话，知道这老头手里肯定有更好的。伸手进背篓里，从空间中拿出短刀，一把抽出短刀说：“这种品质的有吗？”

就在王野短刀抽出的一刹那，老头的眼都直了，结结巴巴的说：“小兄弟，那个，我可以上手摸摸吗？”

王野现在可不怕这么一个老头跟他使什么手段，短刀回鞘递给老头。

老头双手捧着短刀，好像是什么绝世珍宝一样，轻轻的拔出短刀，轻轻的抚摸着刀身，又用手敲了一下，贴近耳朵倾听刀身的颤抖声，然后依依不舍的递还给王野说：“小兄弟，你这就高看老汉了，这种品质的刀我可拿不出来。”

王野继续说：“那你能拿出什么样的，总该给我看看吧！我都给你看了。”

这就是王野的目的：我都给你看了标准了，你再不给我拿出最好的就有点儿就有点掉价了。

老人犹豫再三，从怀里拿出一把小巧的匕首，这把匕首外观很普通，刀鞘还是木头的，没有任何华丽的装饰。

老头把匕首递给王野说：“小兄弟，你先看看这个，能不能入你法眼。”

王野接过匕首，一把抽出，这把匕首居然是乌黑色的，就连刀刃都是黑色的，在灯光的照射下居然一点都不反光。王野用手刮了一下刀刃，明显感觉很锋利，掂了一下，分量要比老头摊位上的压手很多。

王野说：“大爷，这匕首有什么来历吗？”

老人说：“这把匕首要说来历还真有，就是不知道真假。”

王野一听这话觉得挺新鲜，卖东西的人讲故事，先跟顾客说不知道故事的真假。

这一下就燃起了王野熊熊的八卦之心：“大爷，不论真假你就说说吧！我就当听故事了。”

Chapter 52 Visiting the Pigeon Market Again - "Traveling through 60 and Taking Space to Be a Security Guard"

Wang Ye began to stroll slowly, only selling some daily necessities and selling very little food.There are a few antique sellers, but Wang Ye doesn't know these things yet.

It’s not that there were more fakes in later generations than there are now.It’s just that antiques are not valuable now and the cost of counterfeiting is too high, so there are relatively few on the market.As far as Wang Ye's level is concerned, he can't tell the difference between those in the Western Zhou Dynasty and those in the last week.

Wang Ye doesn't know how to rely on others now. He has a ready-made teacher. With Wang Ye's ability, it shouldn't be difficult to learn appraisal.Appraisal is nothing more than knowledge reserve and practical ability.

The knowledge reserve in Mr. Yongning's study should be enough, not to mention the practical ability. There are many antiques in Wang Ye's space, some of which he can use for practice.

Wang Ye walked and looked around, and Wang Ye saw something that interested him.At this time, an old man filled the stall with cold weapons. There is still a market for these things.

Wang Ye squatted in front of the stall, looked at the dazzling array of weapons and said, "Uncle, how do you sell this?"

The uncle said: "Two pieces for large items and one piece for small items. It is best to have food."

Wang Ye picked up a dagger and scraped the blade, weighing it a bit. It felt good, but it was far from his short knife.

Wang Ye asked casually: "Do you have anything better?"

When the stall owner was asked this question, he knew that this was a business opportunity, so he quickly said: "How good do you want, young man? This is already a high-quality product."

When Wang Ye saw the old man answering like this, he knew that the old man must have something better.He reached into his backpack, took out the dagger from the space, pulled out the dagger and said, "Are there any of this quality?"

The moment Wang Ye drew out his short sword, the old man's eyes widened and he stammered, "Little brother, can I touch it?"

Wang Ye was not afraid of what tricks such an old man would use on him now. He returned the short knife to its sheath and handed it to the old man.

The old man held the dagger in both hands as if it were a peerless treasure. He gently pulled out the dagger, stroked the blade gently, knocked it with his hand, listened to the trembling sound of the blade with his ear, and then reluctantly handed it back to Wang Ye and said: "Little brother, you are looking down on this old man. I can't get a knife of this quality."

Wang Ye continued: "Then you should show me what you can come up with! I've shown it to you."

This is Wang Ye's purpose: I've shown you the standards, and if you don't give me the best, the price will drop a bit.

The old man hesitated and took out a small dagger from his arms. The dagger looked very ordinary. The scabbard was made of wood and did not have any gorgeous decorations.

The old man handed the dagger to Wang Ye and said, "Little brother, take a look at this first to see if it can catch your eye."

Wang Ye took the dagger and pulled it out. The dagger was actually jet black, even the blade was black, and it didn't reflect any light under the light.Wang Ye scraped the blade with his hand, and it obviously felt sharp. He weighed it and found that it was much heavier than the one on the old man's stall.

Wang Ye said: "Uncle, what is the origin of this dagger?"

The old man said: "Supposedly, the origin of this dagger is true, but I don't know whether it is true or not."

When Wang Ye heard this, he felt that it was quite novel. When a seller tells a story, he first tells the customer that he doesn't know whether the story is true or false.

This moment ignited Wang Ye's burning desire for gossip: "Uncle, just tell me whether it's true or false! I'll just listen to the story."
